verdict.rationale: Netlify documents its own managed Postgres offering, Netlify Database, which can be provisioned instantly and gives the platform a first-party SQL database. Nothing in the evidence shows how code queries it, such as a serverless driver or HTTP query API, or that connection pooling and connection management are handled for the developer. The Turso entry is a third-party integration and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented in-code query API/driver, explicit no-connection-management behavior, serverless (scale-to-zero/per-request) semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can query a serverless SQL database directly from my code with no connection management
